tours.name: Return Cash Sales Order
tours.description: A friendly step-by-step guide for handling a customer return on a cash sale. You will create and confirm the cash order, deliver the goods, invoice the customer, and then issue a credit note (request approval, approve and confirm) so the customer is not charged for the returned goods. The original invoice is then reset and posted again.

The original invoice is then reset and posted again.
